name: Nango
title: nango.dev
shortDescription: Nango offers a comprehensive integration platform that enables developers to integrate their products with over 400 APIs. It provides full control over integrations, allowing for code-first, customizable solutions that are low maintenance. Ideal for businesses looking to enhance their software with multiple API integrations without the hassle of building each one in-house. Example use case: A tech company uses Nango to rapidly deploy customer-requested integrations, enhancing user satisfaction and retention.
pros: Built-in support for all authorization types
cons: Potential dependency on a third-party platform
Limited to APIs available in Nango's ecosystem
